report.summary: The prior stderr-validity finding is resolved. The evaluator narrowly admits the observed Geant4 construction banners, rejects unrelated stderr, parses the actual single-bin EnergyDeposit layout, and adds regression coverage using the recorded 196-byte stderr pattern and representative CSV. The earlier INCONCLUSIVE result remains preserved and is not presented as evidence; revision 16 prospectively requires fresh runs. No blocking or important findings remain. Review was read-only and tests were not executed, as instructed.
